pages.subtitle: WEEKLY KPI REPORT   |   Week ending: September 2026
bullets: USD MoM inflation rose to 0.28% in July; food was 0.22% and non-food 0.31%.
ZWG eased to 0.10% as USD accelerated to 0.30%, reversing June's pattern.
USD CPI reached 125.61, up 3.12% year on year.
Gold rebounded to US$4,132/oz; platinum and palladium also edged higher.

pages.subtitle: WEEKLY KPI REPORT   |   Energy, fuel and foreign-currency flows
bullets: Generation supplies 1,615MW against 2,200MW demand—a 585MW shortfall.
Petrol and diesel held at US$1.96/1.98, below their first-half peaks.
Q1: diesel +20.2%, Jet A1 +19.4%; petrol -6.5% year on year.
Q2 inflows +15.7%; payments +19.9%; the net surplus improved 7.3%.

pages.subtitle: RBZ · ZSE · VFEX · ZERA   |   17 September 2026
bullets: At 15 Sep, ZSE market cap was US$3.76bn versus VFEX at US$8.05bn (2.1×).
The official rate eased to 26.63 ZiG/US$; the parallel rate held at 33.
31 Jul–6 Aug: the USD mid-rate firmed 0.24% to 26.6194.
June M1, M2 and M3 expanded by roughly 11.5% month on month.

pages.subtitle: RBZ · ZIMSTAT · POTRAZ   |   August 2026
bullets: Q2 access points edged up to 57,384 merchants, 511 ATMs and 156,664 POS devices.
Debit cards rose 5.3% QoQ to 6.79m; mobile users rose 5.2% to 11.25m.
Prepaid cards slipped 1.0%; internet-banking users increased 4.6%.
Econet led Q1 active lines at 12.93m and 74.8% market share.

pages.subtitle: WEEKLY KPI REPORT   |   Banking, stablecoins and mobile money
bullets: The policy rate fell to 30%; average lending rose to 43.9%.
NPLs reached 3.64%, still 1.36pp below the 5% benchmark.
USDT dipped to US$0.9988; other stablecoins held near parity.
Q2 mobile-money shares rose to 13.0% by value and 89.1% by volume.

pages.subtitle: WEEKLY KPI REPORT   |   Growth, employment and agriculture
bullets: 2026 GDP is projected at US$52.0bn, up 14.8% from 2025.
Employment remains 58.5% informal, 35.8% formal and 5.7% household.
Recorded unrest severity fell to 1, from 4–5 around 2024–25 events.
Soyabeans +129%; maize +29%; tobacco +28%; cotton +26%.

pages.subtitle: RBZ · FAP   |   September and 1–30 October 2026
bullets: OTP fraud: 234 cases in September; 88 in 1–30 October. SIM swaps: zero in both periods.
Q1 remittances were US$314m—12.8% of full-year 2025 inflows.
USD transaction share reached 63.5%; ZiG share eased to 36.5%.
June CAR stood at 24.13%, remaining 12.13pp above the 12% benchmark.
